source: [softly] Ever since junior high, Doddy Suryadharma has carried one dream... [pause] to build worlds. To become a game maker — someone who creates places people can step into, and truly feel. [warmly] This portfolio is the very first step of that dream. Not a page to read... but a small world to journey through. [excited] So — welcome, traveler. Your adventure begins now.
